newsitem.title: CHINA: China sells state textile firm for 486 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China sells state textile firm for 486 mln yuan.

text.p: The central China province of Shanxi auctioned a large textile and printing factory whose debts were almost double its assets, the Xinhua news agency reported on Saturday.
Shanxi Textile, Dyeing and Printing factory was sold for 486 million yuan to Taiyuan Cotton Textile State Assets Management Corp on Friday, it said.
It was one of the biggest state enterprises to go under the hammer in China, it added.
Xinhua said the factory, with 15,000 workers and fixed assets of 480 million yuan, was declared bankrupt on September 30 by a local court, it said.
The plant, once listed among the country's top 500 large enterprises, has handed over to the state 670 million yuan in profits and taxes over the past 40 years but fell into debt from 1993, it added.
As a result, the factory accumulated total liabilities of 780 million yuan, before it was offered for auction in Taiyuan, the capital of Shanxi province. The agency gave no more details.
